subject: Welcome!
author: ZombieTron
body: Welcome to Burnoutaholics Jasman ;-) I'm looking forward to racing you sometime!

subject: You know Xandu...
author: SUFFUR
body:
At the next HQ visit, you and me should spend a day, playing to see if we still got it, would be fun to chase you around the track's of Burnout 2 'Point of Impact', the dam race would be good, the long version.

Did you ever crash on the corner, off to the road below, just before the truck, it could cut 6 seconds of your time, if you get it right, darn did I just give away how I got quick times, lol, then again was that the right track, I can't remember, lol.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Burnout 2: Point of Impact rules!!
author: Xandu
body: I remember that as it was yesterday. We both did perfect races and had boost chains in the thirties. I also remember winning the race :-)
